approvers: My bank, my tax adviser and lawyer, and my family
reason: A new Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work. I would not open my books or even spend 30 minutes on it. My adviser would throw it out at the first look.
objection: Belize, no track record, no funding, and 30% of the price paid over three years: my retirement money would sit with a company that may never have any money.
instead: Hand over to family or a successor I know, or list the business on nexxt-change and deal with a buyer my bank and adviser can vet.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of funds held at a German bank, a buyer with a real track record and references from other sellers, and the full price in cash at closing or the deferred part secured by a bank guarantee.
